title: FINNALA sleeper sofa
description: FINNALA sleeper sofa, Grann/Bomstad black FINNALA sofa series has sections that can be combined as you like into a customized solution for you and your home. This one has a sleeper sofa which is super easy to convert with a thick, cozy mattress.
features: The seat cushions, back cushions and inside, top, front of the armrests are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
materialAndCare: Smolder resistant lining/ Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft.; Back frame: Plywood, Fiberboard, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft., Particleboard, Solid wood; Front rail: Plywood, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft., Particleboard; Backrest cushion: 30% cut polyurethane foam/ 70% polyester fibers; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Layer glued slats: Layer-glued wood veneer, Adhesive resin as coating; Seat frame/ Seat frame: Steel, Epoxy/polyester powder coating; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Frame: Plywood, Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft., Particleboard, Solid wood, Fiberboard; Leg: Polypropylene; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Ticking/ Ticking: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Quilt filling: 70 % viscose, 30 % polyester; Backing: 100 % polypropylene; Ticking, underside: 90% viscose, 10% polyester (100% recycled); Comfort filling: Polyurethane foam 1.7 lb/cu.ft.
